baseline: Current complete OrderService.create service round trip; concurrency=1 is the serial control for the same seat count
workload: One session per case; distinct aligned two-seat pairs; same customer, distinct request keys; finite barrier-released closed waves
dataGeneration: One area, one 380.00 tier, 20 enabled seats per row, one aisle segment; row labels R0000..; no randomness; forbidNewOrphan=true
timing: System.nanoTime immediately around OrderService.create, including transaction start/commit, connection and row-lock waits, validations and result loading; HTTP/auth, fixture generation, barrier wait, warmup, assertions and file I/O excluded
throughput: Successful measured orders / sum of measured wave durations; each wave measured from barrier release through all future completions; setup and gaps between waves excluded
percentiles: Nearest rank sorted[ceil(n*q)-1]; small finite samples, not a capacity estimate
